question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits third to the right of F. C sits second to the left of G. G is not an immediate neighbour of F. D sits to the immediate right of E. What is the position of C with respect to A?
solution:
Given that A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

A sits third to the right 
of F.

C sits second to the left of G.

G is not an immediate neighbour of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ee287ac43d9caa36c3b9e3316a6aaf16a67ee9e70544795c5a9737c4017eb7c.png] 

D sits to the immediate right of E
